title: Upholstered brand importing sofas from Vietnam into Los Angeles

input.what: Upholstered furniture brand importing sofas from Vietnam

assumptions: A brand importing upholstered sofas made in Vietnam through the Port of Los Angeles and selling online, with no store (the seller path), so no building permit. Company, tax and city filings as la-upholstered-importer.json. Vietnam isn't China: no Section 301 or antidumping fact may appear; Section 232's tariff on upholstered wooden products applies from any origin.
